name: Validate Full Docker Environment
description: Orchestrator activity to validate all Docker containers (devbob, API server, Redis, SurrealDB) and generate comprehensive environment report

task_steps.description: Check Docker daemon and docker-compose status

prompt.template:
Check Docker environment status:

1. Run: docker --version
2. Run: docker-compose --version
3. Run: docker ps --format 'table {{.Names}}\t{{.Status}}\t{{.Ports}}'
4. Report:
   - Docker version
   - Docker Compose version
   - All running containers
   - Container count
   - Any issues

Provide Docker environment overview.

Execute devbob-clean container validation:

1. Register the validation activity:
   - File: templates/docker/validate-devbob-container.json
   - Use register_activity_template tool

2. Execute the activity:
   - Use activity tool with templateId: "validate-devbob-container"
   - Pass empty variables: {}
   - Reason: "Validate devbob-clean container as part of full environment validation"

3. Review the results from test-results/devbob-container-validation.md

4. Report:
   - Activity execution status
   - Validation result (PASS/WARNING/FAIL)
   - Key findings
   - Any critical issues

Provide devbob validation summary.

Generate comprehensive Docker environment validation report:

1. Read all validation reports:
   - test-results/devbob-container-validation.md
   - test-results/api-server-container-validation.md
   - test-results/redis-container-validation.md
   - test-results/surrealdb-container-validation.md

2. Aggregate results:
   - Count PASS/WARNING/FAIL for each container
   - Identify critical issues across all containers
   - Identify common patterns
   - List all recommendations

3. Create comprehensive report with:
   - Executive Summary (overall PASS/WARNING/FAIL)
   - Per-Container Status Table
   - Critical Issues Section
   - Network Connectivity Matrix
   - Recommendations by Priority
   - Next Steps

4. Save report to: test-results/docker-environment-validation-full.md

Provide overall environment assessment.
